# The shape `uv export` gave transformers while the lock forked it: one package,
# two versions, each behind a platform marker. In uv.lock the vulnerable 5.8.1
# was macOS-only, invisible to an audit on Linux; here it is Windows-only, so
# that neither a Linux nor a macOS test host matches its marker (docs/09 P10-16).
annotated-doc==0.0.5
    # via typer
transformers==5.8.1 ; sys_platform == 'win32'
    # via docling-core
transformers==5.15.1 ; sys_platform != 'win32'
    # via docling-core
